thread:
alejandro ramos: quick follow-up from the RFC meeting — we still haven't picked a good default for continuous-batcher. two mental models:
  1) express-lane/speculative: create tiny speculative batches for interactive flows to cut p95.
  2) batch-first/coalesce: maximize batch density, favor cost and kv-cache stability, accept occasional tail.

emma li: if we do express-lane we should bound the cost with a token budget per-route. otherwise GPUs burn cycles serving lots of 1-2 request batches.

kai watanabe: token-budget sounds good. also add a decay so brief microburst spikes don't exhaust the budget forever. thinking: budget_per_minute + decay_half_life.

alejandro ramos: config sketch i tossed in the meeting notes:
```
policy.type = "hybrid"
policy.express.enabled = true
policy.express.budget = 200  # speculative tokens per minute
policy.express.decay_half_life_s = 60
coalesce.window_ms = 15
coalesce.soft_min = 4  # soft min batch with hysteresis
```

emma li: major tradeoff we saw: express lanes fragment kv-cache. more small batches -> fewer hits -> higher decode time on long-context models. need metric to detect that.

ops-bot: ALERT: batcher.kv_miss_rate increased 12% on canary-42 in last 10m

kai watanabe: that alert correlates with express.enabled on canary. surprise: p95 improved but end-to-end throughput fell due to slower kv loads.

alejandro ramos: so we should make express-mode route-assignable and default-off for high-throughput routes. also expose auto-disable when kv_miss_rate delta > 10% for 5m.

emma li: recommend we surface two simple knobs in the Console: express_mode (on/off/auto) and cost_cap. auto = runtime toggles based on telemetry thresholds (kv_miss, batch_size, wait_ms).

kai watanabe: operational suggestions: 1) lightweight simulator that replays trace and outputs p50/p95, kv_miss, gpu_seconds. 2) grafana tile: batch_size_vs_kv_miss panel. 3) add an alert runbook for when express auto-disable flips frequently.

alejandro ramos: volunteers? emma for the console UX mock, kai for simulator, i'll draft RFC text for auto-disable rules + sample charts. deadline: RFC draft by Tue EOD, sync Fri for final decision.

emma li: i can mock panel + quick Console toggle by Wed.

kai watanabe: sim harness tests on Thu, will paste results here.

ops-bot: NOTE: deploy-bot: canary-42 rolled out express=true at 1718608000

alejandro ramos: thanks. small follow-up: consider an admission weight instead of pure batch-size hedging: speculative requests get higher priority but still join bigger coalesced batches if present. that may preserve kv locality a bit.

emma li: good idea. we can call it priority_score (0..1) where express requests start at 0.9 and decay to 0.1 if waiting.

kai watanabe: ok closing thread until RFC + sim results posted. :thumbsup:
_note: Slack thread style: short back-and-forth, config snippet, bot alert, volunteers and timeline.
